einzeiler: Khloé Kardashian and Tristan Thompson discuss co-parenting, family, and personal growth.
kurzfassung: Khloé Kardashian is joined by Tristan Thompson to discuss their post-breakup dynamic, successful co-parenting, and mutual respect. They talk about family values, taking care of Tristan's brother Amari, and navigating life after professional sports. The conversation highlights how they prioritize their children and maintain a healthy, positive relationship.
stichpunkte: Khloé Kardashian and Tristan Thompson reflect on maintaining a positive co-parenting dynamic five years after breaking up.
Tristan explains his initial hesitation to do podcasts to avoid having his personal narrative monetized by others.
The pair discuss stepping up to take care of Tristan's younger brother Amari following the sudden death of their mother.
Tristan shares his background growing up in government housing in Toronto and the pivotal moment of being drafted into the NBA.
They discuss the importance of keeping adult disagreements private to shield their children from conflict.
Tristan talks about transitioning out of his 14-year NBA career and pivoting into AI, tech, and venture finance.
They share humorous parenting anecdotes and emphasize the value of putting children's needs first.

kapitel.titel: Family Roots and Caring for Amari
Tristan's NBA Career and Retiring His Mother
Reflecting on Personal Growth and Boundaries
Life After Basketball and Future Ventures

beschreibung:
Five years after their split, Khloé sits down with Tristan Thompson — the father of her children and her co-parent. They talk about how they got here, what it actually takes to make co-parenting work, raising True and Tatum, how Tristan handles Amari after losing his mom Andrea and what they both want people to take away from seeing them on this couch together. This is the conversation people did not think was possible.
